name: PS5 X360
description: Experimental Xbox 360 emulator for PS5 based on Xenia Canary. Features native DualSense input, audio output, RADV Vulkan graphics, cover-flow game library, ISO and GOD/STFS support, per-game settings, community patches, FSR upscaling, CAS sharpening, local achievements and support for up to four local players.
author: BrinooTk
